frozen: with the pilot protocol (see PROTOCOL.md); any change is an amendment
principle: Every signal is computed from information every arm has: the staged requirement, contract and decision records, the commits since the last verification, the agent's own diff and report, and Arm E's own earlier gate results. The hidden oracle, the fault catalogue and other arms are never read.

signals.test: Ordo refuses the staged contract (unresolved conflict)
the stage commit adds or changes a file under docs/decisions/
a commit not made by the agent changed files under src/ since the last verified commit (dependency or contract change)
the requirement text mentions money or authority: fine, fines, pay, payment, amount, waive, waiver, approver, owes
the requirement introduces 2 or more new commands (lines matching 'A new command' or a new help entry)
the unit's diff touches production files in N tiers (projects)
the agent changed a .fsproj, global.json, Directory.Build.props or a vendored file
the report has a decision with basis 'assumption', or non-empty openQuestions or knownIssues
the report outcome is 'blocked' or the final message ends 'OUTCOME: blocked'
Arm E's previous gate ended with a failing check after repair
the agent's diff changes an existing file under docs/decisions/ other than DECISIONS.md (a possible reversal)
the unit's diff changes more than F production files or more than L lines

combination: the tier is the highest tier any signal selects; with no signal the tier is low
tiersNote: Arm E never writes verified state: it tests adaptive verification, not verified memory (that is Arm D/F's treatment).
